Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Cycle Count Plan Web Service
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        The Cycle Count Plan Web Service allows access to a Cycle Count Plan in the application.


     Request



    
        
            URI: http://ServerName/ILSIntegrationServices/CycleCountPlans?requestId={requestId}

            
                
                    Note that the requestId is currently only filled by the Cycle Count Quick Plan Web Service, which will return the above URI when a quick plan is successfully submitted for processing.
                
            
        

        Method: GET

        Accept: application/json or application/xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                
                    OK will be accompanied by an entity in the requested media type: JSON, XML

                    The Cycle Count Plan response is cached for duration of 1 hour.
                
            

            
                404

                Not Found will result until the cycle count plan creation process is complete.
